Path: business reporting | 缺项 (no checklist item authors a react-tier `ObjectChart` through objectui's contract face) | P2

## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:spec` · `area:reports` · `pm:queue`

Triage: lands in `packages/types`: `ObjectChartSchema` (TS and zod), its `series` element and its `chartType` requirement ⇒ `domain:spec` (objectui's contract face). Rationale: the react tier's `ObjectChart` on a real showcase page (`examples/app-showcase/src/ui/pages/renewals-pipeline.page.ts:166`, a named producer) becomes an `object-chart` node `{ specType: 'bar', series: [{ name, label }] }`. objectui's published `ObjectChartSchema` refuses that node (`chartType` unset, `series.0.dataKey` missing), while the spec's `ChartSeriesSchema` is the `{ name }` arm. Under ruling `5617465269` principle 1 (objectui#7759), the spec's shape is the authority. Whether any user-facing path runs this schema on the node is unmeasured, and the renderer translates it ⇒ **p3**, the family's grade (objectui#10518, #10584).

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01W89enF2dYV7K4N2Fbfj33f` · 2026-09-27T13:13Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card (no comments), objectui#10584 (in flight) and PR objectui#10768 (open), and objectui#10518 (closed).

**Sequencing.** PR objectui#10768 (objectui#10584) edits the same `ObjectChartSchema.series` docblock that this card falsifies (「All five producers compose it…」) ⇒ serial after it, by the dispatching seat's in-flight check. It is not folded into objectui#10584, which is in flight and covers the `.describe` wording only.

**Execution notes.**
1. **Measure first:** does any runtime, publish or `objectui validate` path run `ObjectChartSchema` on the wrapper's node? Record which.
   - **If one does**, a user meets a refusal: report it here, and the grade is re-read (it may rise).
   - **If none does**, the INTERNAL claim in the docblock is the defect.
2. Align the contract face with the spec: accept the `{ name }` series arm, and take the chart type from `specType` / `type` as the spec's react-blocks entry declares. `Clause-②: yes` if the accept set widens. ⛔ No objectui-only dialect.
3. Pin: the showcase node parses, and a series with neither `name` nor `dataKey` is refused (the control).

Claim: PM loop round 3 — objectui#10770: `ObjectChartSchema` accepts the `object-chart` node that the react tier's `ObjectChart` block produces. That is the spec's `{ name }` series arm, with the chart type taken from `specType` / `type` as the spec's react-blocks entry declares (ruling `5617465269` principle 1). Measure first whether any runtime, publish or `objectui validate` path runs the schema on that node.

- `packages/types/src/objectql.ts` and `packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts`, within the `ObjectChartSchema` block only (the `series` element, the `chartType` requirement, and the docblock's 「All five producers」 claim);
- that pair's `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` rows, if any move;
- one pin (the showcase node parses; a series with neither `name` nor `dataKey` is refused);
- one `.changeset/10770-…md` (`minor` if an accept set widens).

⛔ No objectui-only dialect, and no renderer change unless the measurement names one. Stop on breach; explain in the report.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (TIER_DEFAULT, `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs:12534` on objectstack `16c5a33`; `--tier` refuses objectui paths)
Clause-②: yes
Thread-read: 5856177264
Ruling-ref: 5617465269 (objectui#7759, principle 1); triage `5856177264` (grade and execution notes)
Serial constraints cleared: re-measured on objectui `origin/main` `bf14b6460`.
- Triage's serial predecessor, PR objectui#10768 (objectui#10584, the same docblock), is merged as `d89492c`.
- Of the open PRs, PR objectui#8941 touches `objectql.ts` at `BulkActionDef`, which is disjoint. PR objectui#10787 (objectui#10396) touches only plugin-charts `ObjectChart` tests, and this claim does not touch them.
- objectui#7924 (this round) edits `NamedListView` in the same `objectql.ts`, a disjoint region: ordinary concurrency.

The seat's diagnosis is PR comment `5857715528`: this PR's by-reference `ChartSeries` union / `specType` drives a type-instantiation blow-up somewhere in the whole tree.

**What the patch round must do:**
1. Reproduce the slowness and locate it. Use `tsc --extendedDiagnostics` / `--generateTrace` per package, against the pinned spec and, if feasible, the spec-`main` build the gate uses. Name the package, the file and the construct.
2. Fix the type cost without narrowing the ruled accept set. The `{ name }` arm and `specType` stay by reference, and a node naming no family stays refused.
3. Prove it:
   - the full-tree type-check time against the spec-`main` build, next to base;
   - the regular `Type Check` time;
   - all prior gates green.
4. Merge `main` (⛔ no rebase, no force-push). Push. The seat owns the PR body; list any sentence in it that is now false.
